I am a Sr. Quantitative Risk Analyst at CaixaBank. I have extensive background working with financial data sets and using advanced mathematical implementation to enable risk calculations and control of the financial market positions of the bank.

I recently expanded my skills set to include topics like Quarto, Google BigQuery & Looker, Tableau and QlikSense. Moreover I have an extensive knowledge in the Python libraries: `QuantLib`, `pandas`, `statmodels`, `scikit-learn`, `pytorch`, `streamlit` and `py-shiny` among others. 

I am passionate about gravel and road cycling as well as indie Cinema.
